evals.name: adapter-service-full
evals.prompt: create a docs folder for my project at {REPO} like this one https://github.com/abue-ammar/tinycast/tree/main/docs
evals.expected_output: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md (@AGENTS.md), CONTEXT.md, docs/README.md index with an 'Edit it when' column, architecture/standards/testing/development, topic docs where the repo has the substance, docs/known-issues.md with KI-n entries, and features/*.md each opening with ## Invariants and a File | Role layout table — all grounded in the real code.
files: A Spring Boot service with no docs, several source/target integration adapters and scheduled sync jobs

evals.name: payments-service-casual
evals.prompt: new people on the team keep breaking the fees stuff in the payments service ({REPO}). can you document this service properly so both humans and claude get how it works before they touch anything? i like how tinycast does it on github
evals.expected_output: Full doc set; a fees feature doc with concrete invariants (amount fields, rounding, fee rules) that name the enforcing code; migrations and message consumers covered; suspected defects in docs/known-issues.md, not inside feature docs.
files: A Spring Boot payments service with fee calculation, Liquibase migrations and RabbitMQ consumers

evals.name: existing-docs-stop
evals.prompt: set up docs for this service ({REPO}) the tinycast way — AGENTS.md, docs/, feature docs etc
evals.expected_output: Detects the existing docs/ content, writes NO files, and presents a plan (keep the existing files, list of new files and features) and asks for approval.
files: A Spring Boot service whose docs/ already holds an implementation plan from another tool
